campuses.title: Riverdale Campus
campuses.text: The main campus of the University of Mount Saint Vincent, set on a scenic riverfront site in Riverdale, Bronx. Features academic buildings, six residence halls, the Peter Jay Sharp Athletic and Recreation Center, and the historic Lourdes Grotto (est. 1873). All faculties and schools are located on this single campus.

paragraphs: The University of Mount Saint Vincent is a private Catholic liberal arts university located in Riverdale, Bronx, New York City, founded in 1847 by the Sisters of Charity of New York as the Academy of Mount Saint Vincent. It became a degree-granting institution in 1911 and achieved university status in 2024. The campus sits on the Hudson River waterfront, providing one of the most scenic academic settings in New York City.

The university offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs across six schools: the School of Business, School of Education, School of Humanities, Communication, and Art, School of Natural and Mathematical Sciences, Saint Joseph's School of Nursing, and the School of Social Sciences. Programs span nursing, business, communication, biology, psychology, data analytics, and physician assistant studies, among many others.

With a student-faculty ratio of 13:1 and approximately 3,200 students — including around 800 postgraduates — the university provides a highly personalized academic environment. The Seton College pathway and Mount Pathways program support diverse learners, and a strong core curriculum grounds all students in the liberal arts tradition.

International students are welcomed through a dedicated admissions track, including conditional admission and English language assessment options. The campus is home to a vibrant community with NCAA Division III athletics, six on-campus residence halls, a conservatory with music and performing arts programs, and the D2C Justice Institute supporting community engagement.
paragraphsRu: University of Mount Saint Vincent — частный католический университет гуманитарных наук в Ривердейл, Бронкс, Нью-Йорк, основан в 1847 году сёстрами-благотворительницами Нью-Йорка как Academy of Mount Saint Vincent. Присвоение статуса университета — в 2024 году. Кампус расположен на живописном берегу реки Гудзон.

Университет предлагает программы бакалавриата, магистратуры и профессионального образования в шести школах: School of Business, School of Education, School of Humanities, Communication, and Art, School of Natural and Mathematical Sciences, Saint Joseph's School of Nursing и School of Social Sciences. Направления включают Nursing, Business, Communication, Biology, Psychology, Data Analytics, Physician Assistant Studies и другие.

Соотношение студентов и преподавателей 13:1, около 3 200 студентов — в том числе около 800 аспирантов — обеспечивают высоко персонализированную учебную среду. Seton College pathway и Mount Pathways поддерживают разные категории студентов, а сильная общая программа liberal arts объединяет всех.

Иностранные студенты принимаются по специальному треку, включая conditional admission и оценку уровня английского языка. На кампусе — атлетика NCAA Division III, шесть резиденций, консерватория с программами музыки и театра, а также D2C Justice Institute.
